mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of potassium and creatinine while chlorthalidone causes potassium depletion, creating opposing effects on serum potassium and renal function that require monitoring.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and renal function regularly; consider potassium supplementation or potassium-sparing agent; adjust dosing if renal function declines.
